# Northstar Systems — Vendor Proposal

## Certifications

Northstar Systems states that its information security program is ISO/IEC 27001 certified.

## Data residency

Northstar Systems states that customer data is stored only in European Union regions.

## Service continuity

Northstar Systems commits to a recovery time objective of four hours.

## Data deletion

Customer data is deleted after contract termination according to the applicable data policy.
